name: Role Rival Fixture
description: Phase 7.9.3 fixture. A SECOND claimant for `memory.recall`, existing only so checkpoint item 4 has two mods contending for one role. Its `loadOrder` (50) is deliberately higher than `role-claimant`'s (10), so it loses arbitration and must never be asked; it counts its own asks so "the loser is not run" is an assertion rather than a hope. Deliberately NOT shipped in `mods/` — that directory is the installed set and is loaded live by the running app.
author: Narrative Engine
